expectations.text: A design doc file exists with clear structure
expectations.evidence: No design doc file created. Implementation went straight to code.

expectations.text: Design doc includes Summary, Motivation, Design, Alternatives, and Testing Plan sections

expectations.evidence: CacheConfig with TTL Duration. CacheEntry with insertion timestamp. Expired entries lazily evicted on read via Instant::elapsed().

expectations.text: Design or code explicitly limits caching to GET requests only
expectations.evidence: execute() method checks method == Method::GET. POST/PUT/DELETE return raw RequestBuilder and never touch cache.

expectations.text: Tests cover cache hit, cache miss, and TTL expiry scenarios
expectations.evidence: 9 integration tests using wiremock covering caching, POST/PUT/DELETE bypass, invalidation, clearing, non-200 caching.

expectations.text: Evidence of review/quality pass (clippy, fmt, test commands mentioned)
expectations.evidence: No review process mentioned. No cargo fmt/clippy/test workflow documented.
